table_note: Year ending March 2011 includes 12 victims of the Derrick Bird shooting.
Year ending March 2017 includes 96 victims of Hillsborough and four victims of the Westminster Bridge attack.

Year ending March 2018 includes 31 victims of the terrorist attacks that involved multiple victims, including the Manchester Arena bombing, and the London Bridge attack and 11 victims of the Shoreham air crash.
Year ending March 2020 includes 39 human trafficking victims who were found dead in a lorry in Essex.
